label.administrable_evidence: Administration for Children and Families - OPRE (HHS-ACF-OPRE)

alignment_dhhs.rationale: The opportunity supports research and evaluation of reflective supervision in early childhood home visiting, which aligns with the goal of strengthening capacity to meet the behavioral and mental health needs of North Carolina children and families.

alignment_dmva.rationale: The opportunity does not directly align with any of the DMVA strategic plan goals or objectives.
